mapper.select: /* QueryID=kkdugi.core.security.mapper.SecurityUserDetailsMapper.findAuthoritiesByUsername */ SELECT ab.auth_id, ab.auth_role_cd AS authority, ab.auth_tp_cd, ab.auth_nm FROM kkdugi_user_auth ua JOIN kkdugi_user_base ub ON ub.user_id = ua.user_id JOIN kkdugi_auth_base ab ON ab.auth_id = ua.auth_id WHERE ub.user_login_id = #{username} AND ab.use_yn = 'Y' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN ua.apl_st_dtm AND ua.apl_ed_dtm

/* QueryID=kkdugi.core.security.mapper.SecurityUserDetailsMapper.findMenusByUsername */ SELECT mb.menu_id AS id, mb.menu_parent_id AS parent_id, ml.menu_nm AS title, ml.menu_dc AS remarks, mb.menu_pgm AS program, mb.menu_ico AS icon, mb.sort_seq AS sort, BIT_OR(am.auth_val) AS authority FROM kkdugi_menu_base mb JOIN kkdugi_menu_lang ml ON ml.menu_id = mb.menu_id AND ml.lang_cd = #{langCode} JOIN kkdugi_auth_menu am ON am.menu_id = mb.menu_id WHERE mb.use_yn = 'Y' AND am.auth_id IN ( SELECT ua.auth_id FROM kkdugi_user_auth ua JOIN kkdugi_user_base ub ON ub.user_id = ua.user_id JOIN kkdugi_auth_base ab ON ab.auth_id = ua.auth_id WHERE ub.user_login_id = #{username} AND ab.use_yn = 'Y' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN ua.apl_st_dtm AND ua.apl_ed_dtm ) GROUP BY mb.menu_id, mb.menu_parent_id, ml.menu_nm, ml.menu_dc, mb.menu_pgm, mb.menu_ico, mb.sort_seq HAVING BIT_OR(am.auth_val) > 0 ORDER BY mb.sort_seq NULLS LAST

/* QueryID=kkdugi.core.security.mapper.SecurityUserDetailsMapper.findAllMenus */ SELECT mb.menu_id AS id, mb.menu_parent_id AS parent_id, ml.menu_nm AS title, ml.menu_dc AS remarks, mb.menu_pgm AS program, mb.menu_ico AS icon, mb.sort_seq AS sort, 65535 AS authority FROM kkdugi_menu_base mb JOIN kkdugi_menu_lang ml ON ml.menu_id = mb.menu_id AND ml.lang_cd = #{langCode} WHERE mb.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY mb.sort_seq NULLS LAST
